results.title: Developer Tools First 1000 Users Strategy (2026) | RevenueFast
results.snippet: Do not treat ₹0 (organic) as a fixed benchmark until your offer, audience, and conversion path have been tested. Do not scale outreach before you can explain why the first users or customers stayed engaged after the first interaction.

results.title: How to launch a dev tool on Hacker News
results.snippet: Link out to the GitHub repo. This makes your "offer" more HN dev audience-centric by design. The repo hints at it being easy to run yourself, at it being an actual working product/library/framework, and at it being a dev tool.
